families.title: Assessment Battery
families.intro: Twelve camera-based movement tests. Each one measures a specific area, tells you what it could and could not see, and feeds your daily plan.

measured: Joint angles in the sagittal and frontal planes (shoulder, hip, knee, trunk, shank)
Left/right difference — but only once side identity is established in the calibration pose
notMeasured: Rotation of the hip or shoulder (a single camera cannot recover transverse-plane twist)
Anything clinical: this is not a screen, a diagnosis, or an injury-risk prediction
Exact degrees, until our own validation study is done — you will see bands, not numbers

families.title: Yoga Styles
families.intro: Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin — each with its own page, level map and course list.

children.title: Vinyasa
children.note: Flow modu: poz-poz düzeltme İDDİASIZ — akış ve nefes temposu koçluğu, gevşek skorlama

measured: Standing, seated and kneeling poses — joint angles and hold time
notMeasured: Floor and prone poses are guided but not scored: lying on the floor is where a single camera is weakest
Inversions are demonstrated by the avatar only
Breath is never measured by the camera

families.title: Flexibility Goals
families.intro: Long-run paths with a weekly angle trend, not a stack of videos.

measured: The joint angle the goal is defined by, re-measured on a fixed cadence
notMeasured: How close you are in weeks or months — progress rate is individual and we do not predict it
Changes smaller than our measurement noise: below that threshold we say 'no change', not 'improved'

notMeasured: Your occupation's injury risk — we shape content, we do not assess risk

families.title: Warm-ups for Other Sports
families.intro: Mobility prep that hands off to the training app you actually use.

notMeasured: Anything about the sport itself — that is the partner app's job

families.title: Breath & Wind-down
families.intro: Voice-guided only. No camera, no scoring.

measured: Nothing. These sessions are guided by audio and timed — the camera stays off.
notMeasured: Breath rate, depth or quality — a phone camera cannot measure breathing and we do not pretend otherwise
Meditation state or relaxation of any kind

poseLibraryTiers.reason: Self-occlusion: lying on the floor hides most landmarks from a side camera
Pose models silently swap limb labels on inverted bodies with high confidence (family finding M-019)

whyNotPage.title: What Lissom doesn't do
whyNotPage.intro: Some things we deliberately left out. Here is what, and why.

items.reason: The pose model is validated on adults, and content for minors carries a duty of care we are not set up to meet.
A phone camera cannot measure breathing. Our breath sessions are voice-guided and untimed by the camera.
Lissom is a general wellness app and is not a medical device, so it does not screen, diagnose or predict injury risk. Those claims require clinical validation we have not done and are not seeking.
The practice depends on room temperature, which an app cannot provide or verify.
A single camera cannot recover this reliably. We would rather leave it out than show a number we cannot stand behind.
